title: Senior React Frontend Engineer
shortDescription: We are seeking a passionate React.js developer to build modern, responsive, and animated user interfaces for our enterprise SaaS products.
responsibilities: Develop high-performance, modular React frontend web applications
Collaborate with UX designers to translate wireframes into interactive interfaces
Optimize applications for maximum speed, responsiveness, and accessibility
Integrate RESTful APIs and WebSocket state managers
requirements: Proficient in React 18+, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS
Experience with Framer Motion, React Router, and state management (Redux/Zustand)
Strong understanding of responsive web layout principles and cross-browser compatibility
Familiarity with Git, Vite, and modern CI/CD deployment pipelines

title: Cloud DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer
shortDescription: Looking for an experienced DevOps Specialist to manage AWS cloud deployments, Docker containers, and automated Kubernetes clusters.
responsibilities: Manage and scale multi-tenant AWS and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
Build automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins
Monitor cluster health, implement auto-scaling policies, and manage disaster recovery
Enforce Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and DevSecOps security policies
requirements: Hands-on experience with AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, EKS) and Docker/Kubernetes
Proficiency in Terraform, Bash/Python scripting, and Nginx configuration
Knowledge of Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK logging stacks
AWS Certified Solutions Architect or SysOps certification is a plus

title: SAP Integration Consultant (CPI / ABAP)
shortDescription: Architect and implement SAP CPI & OData integration flows connecting SAP S/4HANA with third-party web & mobile applications.
responsibilities: Design bi-directional integration flows using SAP Cloud Integration (CPI)
Develop custom OData services and ABAP RFC functions in S/4HANA
Troubleshoot API payloads, XML/JSON transformations, and security certificates
Provide technical consulting to enterprise clients during implementation phase
requirements: Solid experience in SAP CPI, Groovy Scripting, and XML/JSON mapping
Hands-on ABAP development experience for OData service creation
Strong domain knowledge in SD, MM, and FI module data structures
Excellent client communication and problem-solving skills

title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
shortDescription: Join our AI team to build predictive health algorithms, computer vision pipelines, and intelligent NLP chatbots for our products.
responsibilities: Train and deploy Python machine learning models using TensorFlow and PyTorch
Build REST APIs in FastAPI to serve real-time model inference
Develop custom RAG pipelines and LLM integrations for enterprise automation
Conduct data cleaning, feature engineering, and performance evaluation
requirements: Strong mathematical foundation in linear algebra, statistics, and ML algorithms
Proficiency in Python, OpenCV, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, and FastAPI/Flask
Experience deploying ML models to AWS Lambda or Docker environments
Passionate about cutting-edge AI breakthroughs and rapid prototyping
